mentions.name: VERDURE
mentions.description: A creative sandbox game where players grow and shape plants through trimming and pruning. It includes an unlockable 'recipe panel' for further customization and lets players build an entire collection of their plant creations, which can be used to recreate real plant designs.
mentions.source_excerpt: VERDURE is a creative sandbox where you grow and shape plants through trimming and pruning. You can also unlock a 'recipe panel' to further customize them and build a entire collection of your creations. I like to try and recreate real plant designs with it. It is a bit unusual.
